nodes.display_name: Corse di rally Sfida di velocità estrema
nodes.long_description:
**Corse di rally Sfida di velocità estrema** offre un'esperienza immersiva di rally VR & simulazione di corse automobilistiche in prima persona. Vivi sterzate naturali, fisica realistica & adrenalina ad alta velocità con comandi VR reattivi su percorsi offroad.

# Modalità di gioco

**Gare rapide:**

Sfida rivali Ghost AI in emozionanti corse.

**Tappe Rally:**

Affronta tracciati diversi, migliora i tuoi tempi & gareggia con pioggia, neve, di giorno & di notte.

**Campionato:**

Costruisci la tua carriera nei campionati Classic, Modern & Pro. Sfida il cronometro & gli avversari, scala la classifica & conquista il podio.

# Assistente di guida

Il copilota virtuale comunica note sul percorso, curve strette, tornanti & cambi di direzione, indicando distanze & velocità consigliate.

# Fisica realistica & abitacolo

Sospensioni, trazione & frenata reagiscono a terra, ghiaia & terreni accidentati. Abitacoli dettagliati, volanti sportivi & tachimetri digitali aumentano l'immersione VR.

# Ambienti & auto

Esplora lunghi percorsi tra foreste, montagne & canyon con meteo dinamico, ciclo giorno-notte & pubblico che applaude. Scegli auto da rally personalizzabili con prestazioni, skin & livree uniche. Attiva Nitro Boost per accelerare sui rettilinei.

Accendi il motore & domina il rally VR ad alta velocità!
nodes.short_description: Vivi il rally VR & la simulazione di corse automobilistiche con fisica realistica, sterzo reattivo & adrenalina ad alta velocità. Guida auto da rally personalizzabili su piste offroad tra foreste, montagne & canyon, con meteo dinamico & gare diurne e notturne. Affronta Gare Rapide, Tappe Rally & Campionati Classic, Modern & Pro. Segui le note del copilota virtuale, sfida la Ghost AI & attiva il Nitro Boost per emozionanti corse VR.

nodes.display_name: 랠리 레이싱 VR : 극한 속도 도전
nodes.long_description:
**랠리 레이싱 VR : 극한 속도 도전** 는 1인칭 시점의 몰입형 VR 랠리 & 자동차 레이싱 시뮬레이션입니다. 직관적인 VR 스티어링, 현실적인 차량 물리, 반응성 높은 핸들링으로 하이스피드 오프로드 레이싱의 짜릿함을 느껴보세요.

# 게임 모드

**퀵 레이스:**

고스트 AI 라이벌과 박진감 넘치는 레이스를 즐기세요.

**랠리 스테이지:**

다양한 코스를 정복하고 최고 기록에 도전하세요. 비, 눈, 낮과 밤의 주행 조건에서 실력을 시험해 보세요.

**챔피언십:**

클래식, 모던 & 프로 챔피언십에서 랠리 커리어를 쌓으세요. 시간과 경쟁자를 상대로 달리고 순위를 올려 시상대를 차지하세요.

# 드라이버 어시스턴트

가상 코드라이버가 급커브, 헤어핀 & 방향 변화에 대한 페이스 노트를 전달합니다. 다음 코너까지의 거리와 권장 속도를 확인하며 주행하세요.

# 현실적인 물리 & 콕핏

서스펜션, 접지력 & 브레이크가 흙길, 자갈, 험한 지형에 반응합니다. 정교한 실내, 스포티한 핸들 & 디지털 속도계가 VR 몰입감을 높입니다.

# 환경 & 차량

숲, 산악 & 협곡의 긴 오프로드 트랙을 탐험하세요. 다이내믹 날씨, 주야간 변화 & 응원하는 관중이 현장감을 더합니다. 고유한 성능과 핸들링을 가진 랠리카를 스킨과 리버리로 꾸미고 니트로 부스트로 가속하세요.

엔진을 켜고 하이스피드 VR 랠리 챔피언에 도전하세요!
nodes.short_description: 현실적인 물리 엔진, 반응성 높은 VR 스티어링, 하이스피드 아드레날린을 느낄 수 있는 몰입형 VR 랠리 & 자동차 레이싱 시뮬레이션! 커스터마이징 가능한 랠리카로 숲, 산악, 협곡의 오프로드 트랙을 질주하세요. 주야간 레이싱과 다이내믹 날씨를 경험하고 퀵 레이스, 랠리 스테이지, 클래식·모던·프로 챔피언십에 도전하세요. 드라이버 어시스턴트의 페이스 노트를 따라 코너를 공략하고 고스트 AI와 경쟁하며 니트로 부스트로 짜릿한 VR 레이싱을 즐기세요.

nodes.display_name: 拉力賽車 VR: 極限速度挑戰
nodes.long_description:
**拉力賽車 VR: 極限速度挑戰** 帶來沉浸式第一身虛擬實境拉力賽車與汽車競速模擬體驗。透過直觀的虛擬實境轉向操控、真實車輛物理及靈敏反應，感受高速越野賽車的刺激與速度感。

# 遊戲模式

**快速賽事：**

與幽靈人工智能對手展開緊張刺激的競速挑戰。

**拉力賽段：**

征服不同路線，刷新最佳時間，在晴天、雨雪、日間及夜間環境中磨練駕駛技巧。

**錦標賽模式：**

在經典、現代及專業三級錦標賽中建立拉力賽車生涯。與時間及其他車手競爭，提升賽季排名，挑戰頒獎台，爭奪冠軍。

# 智能駕駛助手

虛擬領航員提供拉力路書語音提示，提醒急彎、髮夾彎及路線轉向變化，並顯示下一個彎道的距離與建議車速，協助你提前做好準備。

# 真實物理與駕駛艙

懸掛、抓地力及煞車系統會根據泥地、碎石及崎嶇路面作出反應。精緻車廂、運動方向盤及數碼速度錶令第一身駕駛更具臨場感。

# 環境與車輛自訂

馳騁森林、山脈及峽谷的漫長越野賽道，享受動態天氣、日夜光照及觀眾歡呼。選擇性能與操控各異的拉力賽車，以車身塗裝及外觀設計打造個人風格。直路啟動氮氣加速，爆發更強動力。

啟動引擎，挑戰高速虛擬實境拉力賽車冠軍！
nodes.short_description: 體驗沉浸式虛擬實境拉力賽車與汽車競速模擬！真實車輛物理、靈敏轉向及高速駕駛帶來強烈速度感與刺激體驗。駕駛可自訂拉力賽車，馳騁森林、山脈及峽谷越野賽道，享受日夜變化與動態天氣。挑戰快速賽事、拉力賽段及經典、現代、專業三級錦標賽。跟隨智能領航助手的彎道提示及速度建議，與幽靈人工智能對手競速，使用氮氣加速衝向勝利，感受高速虛擬實境賽車的刺激！

nodes.display_name: Corrida de rali VR : Velocidade Extrema
nodes.long_description:
**Corrida de rali VR : Velocidade Extrema** oferece uma experiência imersiva de rally VR & simulação de corrida de carros em primeira pessoa. Sinta a adrenalina da alta velocidade com direção VR intuitiva, física realista & controle responsivo em pistas offroad.

# Modos de jogo

**Corridas Rápidas:**

Enfrente rivais Ghost AI em disputas intensas.

**Etapas de Rally:**

Domine rotas variadas, supere seus recordes & corra sob sol, chuva, neve, de dia & à noite.

**Campeonato:**

Construa sua carreira nas categorias Classic, Modern & Pro. Dispute contra o relógio & outros pilotos, suba na classificação & lute pelo pódio.

# Assistente de pilotagem

Seu copiloto virtual anuncia notas de percurso, curvas fechadas, grampos & mudanças de direção. Distâncias até a próxima curva & velocidades recomendadas ajudam a planejar cada manobra.

# Física realista & cockpit

Suspensão, tração & frenagem reagem à terra, cascalho & terrenos acidentados. Interiores detalhados, volantes esportivos & velocímetros digitais aumentam a imersão VR.

# Ambientes & carros

Explore longas pistas em florestas, montanhas & cânions com clima dinâmico, ciclo dia-noite & torcidas vibrantes. Escolha carros de rally personalizáveis com desempenho, skins & pinturas exclusivas. Ative o Nitro Boost para acelerar nas retas.

Ligue o motor & conquiste as corridas VR em alta velocidade!
nodes.short_description: Viva o rally VR & a simulação de corrida de carros com física realista, direção responsiva & adrenalina em alta velocidade. Pilote carros de rally personalizáveis por florestas, montanhas & cânions offroad, com clima dinâmico & corridas de dia e à noite. Enfrente Corridas Rápidas, Etapas de Rally & Campeonatos Classic, Modern & Pro. Siga as notas do copiloto virtual, desafie a IA fantasma & use o Nitro Boost para muita ação nas corridas VR.

nodes.display_name: Corrida de ralis VR : Velocidade Extrema
nodes.long_description:
**Corrida de ralis VR : Velocidade Extrema** oferece uma experiência imersiva de rally VR & simulação de corridas de carros na primeira pessoa. Sente a adrenalina da alta velocidade com direção VR intuitiva, física realista & controlo preciso em pistas todo-o-terreno.

# Modos de jogo

**Corridas Rápidas:**

Desafia rivais Ghost AI em corridas intensas.

**Etapas de Rally:**

Domina percursos variados, supera os teus recordes & conduz com sol, chuva, neve, de dia & à noite.

**Campeonato:**

Constrói a tua carreira nas categorias Classic, Modern & Pro. Compete contra o relógio & outros pilotos, sobe na classificação & luta pelo pódio.

# Assistente de condução

O teu copiloto virtual anuncia notas de percurso, curvas apertadas, ganchos & mudanças de direção. Distâncias até à próxima curva & velocidades recomendadas ajudam-te a antecipar a estrada.

# Física realista & habitáculo

Suspensão, aderência & travagem reagem à terra, gravilha & terreno acidentado. Interiores detalhados, volantes desportivos & velocímetros digitais reforçam a imersão VR.

# Ambientes & carros

Explora longas pistas em florestas, montanhas & desfiladeiros com meteorologia dinâmica, ciclo dia-noite & público a apoiar. Escolhe carros de rally personalizáveis com desempenho, skins & pinturas distintas. Usa o Nitro Boost nas retas para acelerar.

Liga o motor & conquista as corridas VR a alta velocidade!
nodes.short_description: Vive o rally VR & a simulação de corridas de carros com física realista, direção precisa & adrenalina a alta velocidade. Conduz carros de rally personalizáveis por florestas, montanhas & desfiladeiros todo-o-terreno, com meteorologia dinâmica & corridas de dia e à noite. Enfrenta Corridas Rápidas, Etapas de Rally & Campeonatos Classic, Modern & Pro. Segue as notas do copiloto virtual, desafia a IA fantasma & usa o Nitro Boost para corridas VR intensas.

nodes.long_description:
**Rallye-Rennen VR Extreme Geschwindigkeit** bietet immersives VR-Rallye-Racing & Autorennsimulation in der Ego-Perspektive. Erlebe intuitive VR-Lenkung, realistische Fahrzeugphysik & High-Speed-Offroad-Rennen mit präzisem Handling.

# Spielmodi

**Schnelle Rennen:**

Fordere Ghost-AI-Gegner in spannenden Rennen heraus.

**Rallye-Etappen:**

Meistere abwechslungsreiche Strecken, verbessere Bestzeiten & fahre bei Regen, Schnee, Tag & Nacht.

**Meisterschaft:**

Starte deine Rallye-Karriere in Classic, Modern & Pro. Fahre gegen Zeit & Rivalen, steige in der Gesamtwertung auf & kämpfe um das Podium.

# Fahrerassistent

Dein virtueller Beifahrer liefert Pace Notes für scharfe Kurven, Haarnadeln & Richtungswechsel. Entfernungen & Tempoempfehlungen helfen bei der Streckenplanung.

# Realistische Physik & Cockpit

Federung, Traktion & Bremsen reagieren auf Erde, Schotter & unebenes Gelände. Detaillierte Cockpits, stylische Lenkräder & digitale Tachos verstärken das VR-Fahrgefühl.

# Umgebungen & Autos

Erkunde lange Wald-, Berg- & Canyonstrecken mit dynamischem Wetter, Tag-Nacht-Wechsel & jubelnden Zuschauern. Wähle anpassbare Rallye-Autos mit eigenem Handling, Skins & Lackierungen. Nutze Nitro Boost für zusätzliche Beschleunigung.

Starte den Motor & erlebe High-Speed-Rallye-Action in VR!
nodes.short_description: Erlebe immersives VR-Rallye-Racing & Autorennsimulation mit realistischer Physik, präziser Steuerung & High-Speed-Adrenalin. Fahre anpassbare Rallye-Autos durch Wälder, Berge & Canyons auf Offroad-Strecken bei Tag, Nacht & dynamischem Wetter. Meistere schnelle Rennen, Rallye-Etappen & Classic-, Modern- & Pro-Meisterschaften. Nutze Beifahrer-Ansagen für Kurven, fordere Ghost-AI-Gegner heraus & aktiviere Nitro-Boost für intensive VR-Renn-Action.

nodes.display_name: Course de rallye Défi de vitesse extrême
nodes.long_description:
**Course de rallye Défi de vitesse extrême** offre une expérience immersive de rallye VR & simulation de course automobile en première personne. Profitez d'une direction VR intuitive, d'une physique réaliste & de courses tout-terrain à haute vitesse.

# Modes de jeu

**Courses rapides :** 

Affrontez des adversaires IA fantômes dans des courses intenses.

**Étapes de rallye :** 

Maîtrisez des parcours variés, battez vos records sous la pluie, la neige, de jour & de nuit.

**Championnat :**

Progressez dans les championnats Classic, Modern & Pro. Affrontez le chrono & vos rivaux, grimpez au classement & visez le podium.

# Assistant de conduite

Votre copilote virtuel annonce les virages serrés, épingles & changements de direction. Les notes de parcours indiquent les distances & vitesses recommandées.

# Physique réaliste & cockpit

Suspension, adhérence & freinage réagissent à la terre, au gravier & aux terrains accidentés. Cockpits détaillés, volants stylés & compteurs numériques renforcent l'immersion VR.

# Environnements & voitures

Explorez de longues pistes en forêt, montagne & canyon avec météo dynamique, cycle jour-nuit & foules enthousiastes. Choisissez des voitures de rallye personnalisables avec performances, skins & livrées variés. Activez le Nitro Boost pour accélérer.

Démarrez le moteur & vivez l'adrénaline du rallye VR à haute vitesse !
nodes.short_description: Vivez une expérience immersive de rallye VR & simulation de course automobile avec physique réaliste, direction réactive & adrénaline à haute vitesse. Pilotez des voitures personnalisables sur des pistes tout-terrain en forêt, montagne & canyon, de jour comme de nuit, par météo variable. Découvrez les courses rapides, étapes de rallye & championnats Classic, Modern & Pro. Suivez les notes du copilote, affrontez l'IA fantôme & activez le boost pour une course VR intense.

nodes.display_name: ラリーレース VR : エクストリームスピードチャレンジ
nodes.long_description:
**ラリーレース VR : エクストリームスピードチャレンジ** は、一人称視点で楽しむ没入型VRラリー＆カーレースシミュレーション。直感的なVRステアリング、リアルな車両物理、反応の良いハンドリングで、ハイスピードのオフロードレースを体験しよう。

# ゲームモード

**クイックレース：**

ゴーストAIのライバルと迫力あるレースに挑戦。

**ラリーステージ：**

多彩なコースを攻略し、ベストタイムを更新。雨、雪、昼夜の異なる条件で腕を磨こう。

**チャンピオンシップ：**

クラシック、モダン、プロの3つの大会でラリーキャリアを築こう。ライバルやタイムと競い、総合順位を上げて表彰台を目指せ。

# ドライバーアシスタント

バーチャルコ・ドライバーがペースノートを読み上げ、急カーブやヘアピン、進行方向の変化を案内。次のコーナーまでの距離や推奨速度も確認できる。

# リアルな物理挙動＆コックピット

サスペンション、グリップ、ブレーキが土、砂利、荒れた路面に反応。精巧な車内、スポーティーなステアリング、デジタルスピードメーターがVRの臨場感を高める。

# 環境＆カスタマイズ

森林、山岳、渓谷の長距離コースを走破。ダイナミックな天候、昼夜の変化、観客の声援がレースを盛り上げる。性能や操作感が異なるラリーカーをスキンやカラーリングでカスタマイズ。直線ではニトロブーストで加速しよう。

エンジンを始動し、ハイスピードVRラリーの頂点を目指せ！
nodes.short_description: リアルな物理挙動、直感的なVRステアリング、ハイスピードの興奮を味わえる、没入型VRラリー＆カーレースシミュレーション。森林、山岳、渓谷のオフロードコースを、カスタマイズ可能なラリーカーで疾走。昼夜の変化とダイナミックな天候も楽しめます。クイックレース、ラリーステージ、クラシック・モダン・プロのチャンピオンシップに挑戦。ドライバーアシスタントのペースノートを頼りに、ゴーストAIとの対戦やニトロブーストによる迫力のVRレーシングを体験しよう。

nodes.long_description:
**Раллийные гонки Экстремальный скоростной** — захватывающий VR-симулятор ралли и автогонок от первого лица. Испытайте точное управление, реалистичную физику машин и адреналин скоростных внедорожных гонок.

# Игровые режимы

**Быстрые гонки:**

Соревнуйтесь с призрачными ИИ-соперниками на сложных трассах.

**Раллийные этапы:**

Осваивайте разные маршруты, улучшайте рекорды и гоняйте под дождём, снегом, днём и ночью.

**Чемпионат:**

Постройте карьеру в классах Classic, Modern и Pro. Сражайтесь со временем и соперниками, поднимайтесь в турнирной таблице и боритесь за подиум.

# Ассистент водителя

Виртуальный штурман сообщает заметки о трассе, предупреждает о крутых поворотах, шпильках и смене направления. Подсказки о расстоянии и рекомендуемой скорости помогают подготовиться к манёврам.

# Реалистичная физика и салон

Подвеска, сцепление и тормоза реагируют на грязь, гравий и неровную поверхность. Детализированные салоны, спортивные рули и цифровые спидометры усиливают погружение в VR.

# Трассы и автомобили

Покоряйте длинные лесные, горные и каньонные маршруты с динамической погодой, сменой дня и ночи и поддержкой зрителей. Выбирайте раллийные автомобили с разной управляемостью, меняйте окраску и скины. Используйте нитроускорение на прямых.

Заводите двигатель и покоряйте скоростные VR-ралли!
nodes.short_description: Погрузитесь в VR-ралли и симулятор автогонок с реалистичной физикой, отзывчивым рулевым управлением и адреналином высоких скоростей. Управляйте настраиваемыми раллийными машинами на внедорожных трассах среди лесов, гор и каньонов при смене дня, ночи и погоды. Вас ждут быстрые гонки, раллийные этапы и чемпионаты Classic, Modern и Pro. Следуйте подсказкам штурмана, соревнуйтесь с призрачным ИИ и используйте нитроускорение для захватывающих VR-гонок.

nodes.display_name: carreras de rally VR: velocidad extrema
nodes.long_description:
**carreras de rally VR: velocidad extrema** ofrece una experiencia inmersiva de rally VR & simulación de carreras de coches en primera persona. Siente la adrenalina a alta velocidad con dirección VR intuitiva, física realista & manejo preciso en carreras offroad.

# Modos de juego

**Carreras Rápidas:**

Compite contra rivales de IA fantasma en emocionantes pruebas.

**Etapas de Rally:**

Domina rutas variadas, supera tus mejores tiempos & conduce con sol, lluvia, nieve, de día & de noche.

**Campeonato:**

Desarrolla tu carrera en Classic, Modern & Pro. Compite contra el reloj & otros pilotos, asciende en la clasificación & lucha por el podio.

# Asistente de conducción

Tu copiloto virtual anuncia notas de rally sobre curvas cerradas, horquillas & cambios de dirección. Las distancias hasta la siguiente curva & las velocidades recomendadas te ayudan a anticiparte.

# Física realista & cabina

Suspensión, tracción & frenado responden a tierra, grava & terrenos accidentados. Interiores detallados, volantes deportivos & velocímetros digitales aumentan la inmersión VR.

# Entornos & coches

Explora largos circuitos entre bosques, montañas & cañones con clima dinámico, ciclo día-noche & público animando. Elige coches de rally personalizables con rendimiento, diseños & carrocerías diferentes. Activa Nitro Boost para acelerar en las rectas.

Arranca el motor & conquista el rally VR a alta velocidad.
nodes.short_description: Disfruta del rally VR & la simulación de carreras de coches con física realista, dirección precisa & adrenalina a alta velocidad. Conduce coches de rally personalizables por bosques, montañas & cañones offroad, con clima dinámico & carreras de día y noche. Compite en Carreras Rápidas, Etapas de Rally & Campeonatos Classic, Modern & Pro. Sigue las notas del copiloto virtual, desafía a la IA fantasma & activa el Nitro Boost para vivir intensas carreras VR.

nodes.display_name: Ralli Yarışı VR : Aşırı Hız Mücadelesi
nodes.long_description:
**Ralli Yarışı VR : Aşırı Hız Mücadelesi**, birinci şahıs bakış açısıyla sürükleyici VR ralli yarışı & araba yarışı simülasyonu sunar. Sezgisel VR direksiyon kontrolü, gerçekçi araç fiziği & hassas yol tutuşuyla yüksek hızlı offroad yarışlarının adrenalinini yaşayın.

# Oyun Modları

**Hızlı Yarışlar:**

Heyecanlı pistlerde Hayalet Yapay Zekâ rakiplerine meydan okuyun.

**Ralli Etapları:**

Farklı rotalarda ustalaşın, en iyi sürenizi geliştirin; güneş, yağmur, kar, gündüz & gece koşullarında yarışın.

**Şampiyona Modu:**

Classic, Modern & Pro şampiyonalarında ralli kariyerinizi kurun. Zamana & rakip sürücülere karşı yarışın, sezon sıralamasında yükselin & podyum için mücadele edin.

# Sürücü Asistanı

Sanal yardımcı pilotunuz keskin virajlar, saç tokası dönüşleri & yön değişiklikleri için yol notlarını seslendirir. Sonraki viraja kalan mesafe & önerilen hız, rotayı önceden planlamanızı sağlar.

# Gerçekçi Fizik & Kokpit

Süspansiyon, çekiş & frenler toprak, çakıl & engebeli zemine tepki verir. Detaylı kokpitler, sportif direksiyonlar & dijital hız göstergeleri VR sürüş deneyimini güçlendirir.

# Ortamlar & Arabalar

Dinamik hava koşulları, gündüz-gece döngüsü & tezahürat yapan kalabalıklarla orman, dağ & kanyon pistlerinde yarışın. Farklı performans ve yol tutuşa sahip özelleştirilebilir ralli arabalarını kaplama & tasarımlarla kişiselleştirin. Düzlüklerde Nitro Boost kullanarak hızlanın.

Motoru çalıştırın & yüksek hızlı VR ralli heyecanını yaşayın!
nodes.short_description: Gerçekçi fizik, hassas VR direksiyon kontrolü & yüksek hız adrenaliniyle sürükleyici VR ralli ve araba yarışı simülasyonunu yaşayın. Özelleştirilebilir ralli arabalarıyla orman, dağ & kanyonlardaki offroad pistlerde, gündüz-gece & dinamik hava koşullarında yarışın. Hızlı Yarışlar, Ralli Etapları & Classic, Modern, Pro Şampiyonalarını keşfedin. Sürücü Asistanı'nın viraj notlarını takip edin, Hayalet Yapay Zekâ rakiplerine meydan okuyun & Nitro Boost ile hızlanın.

nodes.display_name: 拉力赛车 VR: 极限速度挑战
nodes.long_description:
**拉力赛车 VR: 极限速度挑战** 带来沉浸式第一人称虚拟现实拉力赛车与汽车竞速模拟体验。通过直观的虚拟现实方向盘操控、真实车辆物理与灵敏转向，感受高速越野赛车的速度与激情。

# 游戏模式

**快速竞赛：**

与幽灵人工智能对手展开紧张刺激的赛车挑战。

**拉力赛段：**

征服不同路线，不断刷新最佳成绩，在晴天、雨雪及昼夜条件下磨练驾驶技巧。

**锦标赛模式：**

在经典、现代与专业三级锦标赛中开启拉力赛车生涯。与时间和对手竞争，提升赛季排名，冲击领奖台，争夺冠军荣耀。

### 智能驾驶助手

虚拟领航员实时播报拉力路书，提醒急弯、发夹弯及转向变化，并提供前方弯道距离与建议车速，帮助你提前规划驾驶路线。

# 真实物理与驾驶座舱

基于物理的悬挂、抓地力及制动系统会对泥地、碎石和崎岖地形作出真实反应。精致汽车内饰、运动方向盘及数字速度表增强第一人称驾驶沉浸感。

# 环境与赛车改装

驰骋森林、山脉与峡谷中的漫长越野赛道，体验动态天气、昼夜光照及观众欢呼。选择不同性能与操控特性的拉力赛车，通过车身涂装、纹理及外观设计打造专属座驾。直线路段可启动氮气加速，释放更强动力。

启动引擎，征服高速虚拟现实拉力赛车挑战！
nodes.short_description: 体验沉浸式虚拟现实拉力赛车与汽车竞速模拟！真实车辆物理、灵敏转向和高速驾驶带来强烈的速度感与肾上腺素冲击。驾驶可自定义拉力赛车，驰骋森林、山脉与峡谷越野赛道，体验昼夜变化与动态天气。挑战快速竞赛、拉力赛段及经典、现代、专业三级锦标赛。根据智能领航助手的弯道提示与速度建议精准驾驶，与幽灵人工智能对手竞速，使用氮气加速冲向胜利，享受刺激的虚拟现实赛车体验！

nodes.display_name: Rally Racing VR: Xtreme Speed Challenge
nodes.long_description:
**Rally Racing VR: Xtreme Speed Challenge** delivers immersive first-person VR rally racing & car racing simulation with intuitive steering, realistic vehicle physics & high-speed offroad action. Feel every turn through responsive VR controls and terrain-based handling.

# Game Modes

**Quick Races:** 

Jump into fast-paced races against Ghost AI rivals.

**Rally Stages:** 

Master scenic routes, beat your best times & tackle rain, snow, daylight & night driving.

**Championship Mode:** 

Build your rally career across Classic, Modern & Pro championships. Race against the clock & rival drivers, climb season standings & fight for the podium.

# Driver Assistant

Your virtual rally co-driver calls out pace notes for sharp corners, hairpins & changing turns. Distance markers & recommended speeds help you anticipate the road ahead.

# Realistic Driving & Cockpit

Physics-based suspension, traction & braking respond to dirt, gravel & rugged terrain. Detailed car interiors, stylish steering wheels & digital speedometers make each first-person drive more immersive.

# Environments & Customizable Cars

Explore long, beautifully detailed forest, mountain & canyon tracks with dynamic weather, day-night lighting & cheering crowds. Choose rally cars with distinct performance, skins & liveries. Trigger Nitro Boost on straights for an exhilarating burst of extra acceleration.

Start your engine, master technical routes & chase victory in a thrilling VR motorsport racing experience.
nodes.short_description: Experience ultimate VR rally racing & car racing simulation with realistic driving physics, responsive VR steering & high-speed adrenaline. Drive customizable rally cars through stunning offroad environments, forests, mountains & canyons with dynamic weather & day-night racing. Conquer Quick Races, Rally Stages & Championship Mode across Classic, Modern & Pro tiers. Master every turn with Driver Assistant pace notes, challenge Ghost AI rivals & unleash Nitro Boost for intense VR racing action

node.display_name: Rally Racing VR: Xtreme Speed Challenge

nodes.display_name: Rally Racing VR: Xtreme Speed Challenge
nodes.long_description:
Rally Racing VR: Xtreme Speed Challenge delivers an intense rally racing experience built for VR. The game’s standout feature is its intuitive VR car controller, allowing natural steering & smooth handling that responds instantly to your movements. This realistic control system gives you strong sense of speed & true rally immersion

Realistic Car Physics & Interior

Authentic rally physics bring believable vehicle reactions on dirt, gravel, & rugged terrain. The detailed interior, stylish steering wheel, & digital speedometer enhance the feeling of acceleration and control.

Beautiful & Dynamic Environments

Race through long, visually rich environments including forests, offroad, & mountains. Each track supports day & night driving & multiple weather conditions, offering variety, atmosphere, & a deeper sense of adventure. Cheering crowds react as you race, adding energy to every stage

Exotic & Customizable Cars

Choose from multiple exotic cars, each with unique performance & visuals. Customize your vehicles with textures, & skins to create your own racing style. Every car feels distinct in both handling & appearance

Rally Challenges & High-Speed Action

Compete through checkpoints, technical rally routes, and rugged offroad paths. When you need a burst of speed, activate Nitro Boost to power through straightaways & gain an edge in intense moments

Start the engine, feel the control in your hands, & experience rally racing the way it’s meant to be fast, immersive, & real.
nodes.short_description: Rally Racing VR: Xtreme Speed Challenge delivers immersive speed with a highly responsive VR car controller that makes every turn feel natural & precise. Race through long, detailed environments across forests, mountains, & canyon routes, each enhanced with day night lighting & dynamic weather. Experience realistic interiors, a digital speedometer, & smooth car handling that reacts authentically to terrain. Choose from customizable cars & enjoy fast offroad racing built for true VR immersion.

nodes.change_log:
# Rally Racing VR – v2.0.11
# Major Gameplay Update

This major update introduces Championship Mode, Rally Stages, significantly improved steering and vehicle handling, an enhanced rally co-driver, and a new Reset & Respawn system. Experience more realistic driving, smoother controls, improved progression, and greater immersion across every rally stage.

# � New Championship Mode
- Compete in Classic, Modern, and Pro championships.
- Race against rival drivers and the clock across multiple rally stages.
- Climb the season standings, fight for the podium, and become a rally champion.
- Progress through championships using your unlocked tracks.

# � Rally Stages Mode
- Take on challenging rally stages across different tracks and weather conditions.
- Improve your best times and earn coins for completing stages.
- Unlock additional tracks and access them across all racing modes.

# � Major Steering & Handling Improvements
- Significantly improved steering responsiveness and high-speed control.
- Enhanced rally-style brake drifting and cornering behavior.
- More realistic vehicle physics, braking, suspension, and traction.
- Improved stability on slopes and uneven terrain.
- Each car now features distinct handling based on drivetrain, weight, grip, and performance.
- Fixed steering wheel movement and several control responsiveness issues.

# � Improved Rally Co-Driver
- Faster and more accurate pace-note delivery for upcoming corners.
- Improved guidance through consecutive turns and technical sections.
- New adjustable Driver Assistant volume settings.

# � New Reset & Respawn System
- Automatic respawn when your car overturns.
- Hold B for 2 seconds to manually respawn when stuck.
- Resume from your last completed track section instead of restarting.
- Clear on-screen countdown and respawn progress indicators.

# � Additional Features & Improvements
- New seat height adjustment with per-car saved preferences.
- Improved track unlocking and progression across all game modes.
- New track selection and purchase interface.
- Updated How to Play instructions.
- Improved minimap accuracy, waypoint detection, and checkpoint tracking.
- Fixed finish-line, profile, and race timing issues.
- Additional gameplay refinements and bug fixes.

**Take control, master every stage, and race your way to championship glory in Rally Racing VR!**
